references.text: Abraham showed hospitality to heavenly visitors by offering them food, just as Manoah wanted to prepare a young goat for the angel of the Lord.
Lot invited the angels to eat with him, showing the same tradition of hospitality that Manoah demonstrated.
Gideon also offered a young goat to the angel of the Lord when he met him, a parallel situation to Manoah's offering.
The angel declined to eat the food but suggested that Manoah could offer it as a burnt offering to the Lord.
Manoah followed through with his offering by sacrificing the young goat on the rock, and the angel ascended in the flame.
The exhortation to show hospitality because some have entertained angels without knowing it connects to accounts like this one about Manoah.
